author: Karl Rock
description:
Pakistan has an ancient fort hidden deep in rural Sindh that very few tourists ever make it to.

In this video, I travel deep into rural Sindh, Pakistan, to explore Kot Diji Fort and the ancient archaeological site that sits beneath it. The journey itself is part of the experience, taking us through rural villages, farmland, irrigation canals and date-palm plantations before we finally reach the enormous fort overlooking Kot Diji.

Along the way, we stop at a traditional roadside dhaba for chai, where you can see how food is cooked in a wood-fired tandoor, how milk tea is prepared with tea, sugar and gur (jaggery), and how these roadside stops form an important part of everyday life in Pakistan. title: Pakistan’s Ancient Fort Nobody Visits | Kot Diji Full Tour
